description_zh: 两车在路口均左转进入同一车道，前车（AV）以11 mph减速行驶，后车（ego）以18 mph从后方追尾。选取后车作为ego，测试其在左转跟车时能否避免追尾。

source_snippets: Car 1 ... performed the turn from the second lane from the left and was travelling 11 mph when Car 1 then slowed down while still in the intersection.
Car 2 (Ford f-150 XLT), traveling at 18 mph and also making a left turn from Coleman Ave within the same lane as car 1, struck and rear ended car 1 while both cars were still in the intersection.
evidence.reason: 两车均为移动的汽车，后车追尾前车。前车减速（定性为gradually），后车速度较高，适合作为ego测试跟车防追尾能力。选择后车为ego，前车作为NPC使用front_brake模拟减速。
